request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

The person is a recurring course character, so the face must match the reference exactly.

Image 1 shows Diego. Keep his face, dark curly hair with a little grey, short full beard, skin tone and build exactly, and his burgundy button shirt. Create a new photograph at Ana's family party in the sunny green garden behind her house on a warm afternoon: a long table with a white tablecloth, plates and a big cake, colorful paper lanterns and a few balloons hang from the trees, with no letters or numbers anywhere. Diego stands near the balloons and looks straight at the camera with a friendly, curious smile and holds one hand open, palm up, toward the side, as if asking the viewer a question. The face is fully visible and in sharp focus, seen from the head to the waist. Only Diego is in the photo.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-11-16; before tax, not an invoice.
